subject: R error when using time for budget with minimum number of instances

messages.author: 8cf3efa7f5b6699d
messages.subject: R error when using time for budget with minimum number of instances
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm trying to set up irace in order to use the "maxTime" option for budgeting experiments. I managed to modify the target runner to return a "cost time" string and it seemed to go smoothly, but after finishing the first iteration it crashes. To do quick tests, I use a dummy set of instances with the minimum amount of 5 instances, which works with the "maxExperiments" option. I tried adding a sixth dummy instance and irace works! I tried with 5 instances and deterministic=FALSE and it also succeeds.

My actual tuning set is going to be bigger than the minimum so it's not technically a problem for me, but I thought you might wanna know!
